items.event_location_name: SPAR warehouse, Letališka cesta, BTC area, Ljubljana
items.description: Industrial fire case in the BTC/SPAR area. Daily NO2 values are analyzed for December 2025.
items.interpretation_note: A large warehouse fire occurred in the SPAR logistics/warehouse area on Letališka cesta in Ljubljana on 14 December 2025. The dashboard analyzes daily Sentinel-5P NO2 values for the full month of December 2025 and marks the fire day as the event window.
items.confidence_note: Exact fire date is known. The NO2 analysis shows temporal and spatial association only; it does not prove causation without ARSO ground measurements and meteorological validation.

items.description: Major Goriški Kras wildfire of July 2022. Daily NO2 values are analyzed for July 2022.
items.interpretation_note: The major Goriški Kras wildfire started on 15 July 2022 and lasted until the end of July 2022, with the national response plan revoked on 1 August 2022. The dashboard analyzes daily Sentinel-5P NO2 values for July 2022 and marks 15–31 July as the wildfire event window.
items.confidence_note: The event period is well documented. NO2 is not the strongest wildfire-smoke indicator; PM2.5, CO or aerosol indicators would be better for smoke impact. Use NO2 as a first satellite-based regional indicator and document this limitation.

items.description: Industrial case study related to the Celje area and Cinkarna Celje. Daily NO2 values are analyzed for December 2019 within a broader long-term industrial air-quality context.
items.interpretation_note: This is not a single-day accident event. It is an industrial case study related to the Celje area and Cinkarna Celje. December 2019 is used as an analysis month within a broader long-term industrial air-quality context.
items.confidence_note: Treat this as a case-study period, not as a one-day event. Interpretation should be supported with ARSO ground measurements and the Cinkarna Celje air-quality thesis context.
